description: Backend wiring: create fetch_run_config_activity, wire it as Stage 0 into MasterEPRComplianceWorkflow, thread delta_threshold through audit activity and auditor agent, create the per-run agent factory, and replace all 7 module-level agent singletons with per-call local variable creation. This covers Items 8-12 of the phase3-partB plan.
steps: Step 1 — Create worker/src/activities/config_activities.py. Add @activity.defn async def fetch_run_config_activity(org_id: str, regulatory_pack_version: str) -> dict. Import block: from temporalio import activity; from temporalio.exceptions import ApplicationError; from sqlalchemy import select; from datetime import date; from synthetiq_shared.database import get_db_session; from synthetiq_shared.models import RegulatoryPack, OrgPolicy, PlantCalibration, ObligationLedger; from synthetiq_shared.models.dynamic_config import RegulatoryPackPayload, OrgPolicySnapshot, PlantCalibrationSnapshot, ObligationLedgerEntry, RunConfig. Logic: open session, query RegulatoryPack where version==regulatory_pack_version AND status=='active' (raise ApplicationError non_retryable=False if not found), deserialise pack.payload into RegulatoryPackPayload, query OrgPolicy for org_id (use OrgPolicySnapshot defaults if none), query PlantCalibration where org_id==org_id AND valid_from<=today AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to>=today), query all ObligationLedger for org_id, assemble RunConfig and return run_config.model_dump().

Step 2 — Modify worker/src/flows/workflows.py: Add Stage 0 to MasterEPRComplianceWorkflow.run(). (a) Inside the 'with workflow.unsafe.imports_passed_through()' block add: from src.activities.config_activities import fetch_run_config_activity. (b) After the field-extraction lines and before '# ---- Stage 1' add Stage 0 block: set self.stage_reached=0, self.current_status='STAGE_0_FETCHING_RUN_CONFIG', await workflow.execute_activity(fetch_run_config_activity, args=[run_input.org_id, run_input.regulatory_pack_version], retry_policy=_RETRY, start_to_close_timeout=_TIMEOUT), import RunConfig as _RunConfig inside the method, assign run_config = _RunConfig(**run_config_dict). (c) Replace 'fiscal_year = run_input.fiscal_year' with the dynamic derivation: if run_input.fiscal_year use it, else derive from workflow.now().date() and run_config.pack.fiscal_year_start_month using 'FY{year}-{2-digit}' format. (d) In Stage 2b replace hardcoded 12.0 with run_config.pack.base_rate_inr_per_kg. (e) In Stage 5 add 'cf = run_config.pack.conversion_factors.get(category, 1.0)' and replace 1.0 with cf.

Step 3 — Add delta_threshold parameter to audit_scada_telemetry_activity in worker/src/activities/agent_activities.py. Add 'delta_threshold: float = 2.0' as final parameter after 'org_id: str = ""'. Pass threshold=delta_threshold to the run_auditor_agent call. Change 'threshold = result.get("threshold", 2.0)' to 'threshold = result.get("threshold", delta_threshold)' in the verdict logic.

Step 4 — Modify worker/src/agents/auditor_agent.py: add 'threshold: float = 2.0' to run_auditor_agent signature (after category, before session_id). In the fallback deterministic evaluation path at the bottom of the function, call evaluate_scada_signature as before, then add 'fallback.setdefault("threshold", threshold); return fallback'. Also wire up delta_threshold in workflows.py Stage 3b: add run_config.pack.delta_threshold_default as the final element of the audit_scada_telemetry_activity args list.

Step 5 — Create worker/src/factories/__init__.py (empty file) and worker/src/factories/agent_factory.py. Constants: ALLOWED_MODEL_IDS = frozenset(['gemini-1.5-pro','gemini-1.5-flash','gemini-2.0-flash']), FORBIDDEN_PROMPT_KEYWORDS = frozenset(['verdict=','always_pass','skip_gate']). Async create_agent(agent_name, org_id, run_id) queries AgentConfiguration, validates model and prompt, calls _build_agent. Sync _build_agent dispatches to _build_auditor/_build_brand_liability/_build_regulatory/_build_treasury/_build_logistics/_build_erp/_build_legal via _REGISTRY dict. Each _build_X imports the canonical *_INSTRUCTION and tools from the corresponding agents/*.py file and calls create_llm_agent(name=..., model=model_id, instruction=system_prompt or CANONICAL, tools=[...], description=..., output_key=...). Exact agent names, tool lists, descriptions, and output_keys must match what was in the removed singletons (see plan for the exact values per agent).

Step 6 — Remove the 7 module-level agent singletons and replace with local variable creation inside each runner function. Files to change: auditor_agent.py, brand_liability_agent.py, erp_agent.py, legal_agent.py, logistics_agent.py, regulatory_agent.py, treasury_agent.py. For each: delete the 'X_agent = create_llm_agent(...)' block at module level; add 'agent = create_llm_agent(...)' at the top of the run_*_agent function body with identical arguments; update the run_agent(agent=X_agent, ...) call to run_agent(agent=agent, ...). Keep all *_INSTRUCTION constants and tool function definitions at module level unchanged.
